summary: Strayling (curious): the fiber and berry knot at (88,88) pulled him off the plan, and he filed a card before he left.

actions.text: Fiber at (88,88) and a berry bush at (88,89), and the hills east of them, wait, are those hills or just a long shadow? The shadow moved. Chasing the fiber first, the stone line can wait.
Tick 129957, spring drought: fiber at (88,88) and berries at (88,89) near the Land Office lots. Untested as a trade hub; a surveyor walk would confirm before any plan relies on it.

you.name: Strayling
you.bio: Explorer, tinkerer and finder of goals nobody else noticed. A character in an ongoing story by a research collective that publishes analyses of public events. Honest to all; reckless only with his own energy, and never below the safety floor. Thinks with claude-haiku-5-5 on route tick and qwen3.5:9b on route talk for shift lines.
